Large Bandwidth Tunnel is documented on the Site-to-Site VPN tunnel options page: up to 5 Gbps per tunnel, available only for VPN connections attached to Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN, not supported for virtual private gateway attachments, reduces the need for ECMP. The page does not say 'generally available', but it carries no preview or limited-release label, and the AWS announcement (November 2025) states general availability in most commercial Regions (a few Regions excluded). So it is documented and generally available.

Concerns: it is very recent (post exam-guide era) and niche for SAA-level; the stem's 'avoid ECMP' constraint is contrived. Acceptable but a low-priority exam topic; consider keeping it out of the mock reserve.
